info.name: GeniusRX — Healthcare Hub API
info.description:
Role-wise organized API collection for GeniusRX Healthcare Hub.

**Folder structure:**
- 🔐 Auth & OTP — shared by all roles (register, login, OTP, password)
- 📤 Upload — shared by all roles
- 👤 Job Seeker — all screens: onboarding, jobs, applications, resume, ATS, messages, etc.
- 🏢 Recruiter — all screens: company setup, job management, applicants, browse seekers
- 🎓 Instructor — all screens: profile setup, browse seekers, messages
- 🛡️ Admin / Super Admin — dashboard, user management, jobs, reports, CMS

**Quick start:**
1. Import this collection
2. Open '🔐 Auth & OTP → Login' → hit Send → tokens are saved automatically
3. All other requests use {{accessToken}} from collection variables

**Base URL:** https://nizamshejan7000.merinasib.shop/api/v1
